scope: POST /api/local-assets/delete with synthetic files and isolated public-code copy

beforeFix.legacyCanvasBatch: Deleting classic.png, smart.png and free.png removed all three even though legacy ordinary and smart nodes still referenced the first two.
beforeFix.libraryAndHistory: Deleting library.png and history.png removed both despite persisted references.
beforeFix.caption: After the first fix, deleting captioned.png still removed its captioned.txt sidecar even though a canvas referenced that text file.

afterFix.legacyCanvasBatch: Only free.png was deleted. The two referenced files stayed intact; the ordinary canvas list entry normalized a missing kind to classic, and GET /api/storage-files/local/classic.png returned HTTP 200 with the original bytes.
afterFix.libraryAndHistory: Referenced local uploads stayed on disk and were reported in skipped_referenced.
afterFix.sidecars: A reference to captioned.txt preserved the requested image, caption and classification sidecar as one group. An unreferenced group was deleted together.
afterFix.unreadableDocuments: Malformed canvas or history JSON blocked deletion instead of assuming the file was free.

pageLogic: Two JavaScript tests executed the actual asset-manager and smart-canvas deletion handlers. Partial deletion showed one deleted and one retained in Chinese and English; the smart-canvas handler reported retention instead of false success.

pageActions.fixture: Temporary public-code copy with synthetic 1x1 PNG used.png and free.png, legacy-classic-ui and legacy-smart-ui JSON canvases; no API/, data/ or assets/ from the project was copied.
pageActions.assetManager: On /static/asset-manager.html, the Local Assets tab showed two cards. Clicking used.png then Delete showed the visible status '1 个素材仍被使用或无法确认安全，已保留' and left the card. Clicking free.png then Delete showed '已删除 1 个素材', reduced the folder count to 1, and removed the card. Clicking Refresh left only used.png.
pageActions.classicCanvas: After the deletion actions, /static/canvas.html?id=legacy-classic-ui rendered the old ordinary canvas and its image element reported complete=true, naturalWidth=1, naturalHeight=1, src=/assets/uploads/used.png.
pageActions.smartCanvas: After the same actions, /static/smart-canvas.html?id=legacy-smart-ui normalized the legacy smart-container and its image element reported complete=true, naturalWidth=1, naturalHeight=1, src=/assets/uploads/used.png.
pageActions.httpAndDisk: GET /api/storage-files/local/used.png returned 200 with 68 bytes; free.png returned 404. The used image and both sidecars remained on disk; free image and both sidecars were absent after refresh.

verification.python: 5 focused unittest cases passed in a temporary copy containing only main.py, static/, workflows/ and the new test; no real API, data or assets were copied.
verification.javascript: 2 focused node:test cases passed; modified scripts passed node --check; i18n validator passed with 1084 keys.

limits: The page check used a temporary localhost server and browser tab with synthetic files only; no external provider or user data was involved.
